levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Rule changes partway through, or piles don't match the stated rule.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One rule applied consistently across all items.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Rule applied consistently and the learner names a case where it would fail.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Does not check or compare the label.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Checks the label and accurately states whether it matches their rule.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Checks the label, states the match, and revises the rule to be more accurate.

lookFors: At least three distinct piles exist.
Stated rule is specific enough that another person could sort the same way.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
